prompt: List each constructor-season combination where the constructor scored more than 100 total points, for seasons after when points systems became comparable. Show the constructor name, year, and total points. Aggregate points from individual race results.
gold_query: SELECT c.name AS constructor, ra.year, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM ErgastF1.results r JOIN ErgastF1.constructors c ON r.constructorId = c.constructorId JOIN ErgastF1.races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.year >= 2010 AND r.position IS NOT NULL AND r.position > 0 GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, ra.year HAVING SUM(r.points) > 100
submitted_query:
SELECT c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, SUM(res.points) AS total_points
FROM ErgastF1.results AS res
JOIN ErgastF1.constructors AS c ON res.constructorId = c.constructorId
JOIN ErgastF1.races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year >= 2010
GROUP BY c.name, r.year
HAVING SUM(res.points) > 100
ORDER BY r.year, total_points DESC;

prompt: Find the top 30 F1 drivers (first name and last name) by race completion rate, only including drivers with at least 50 race starts. Include total races, completed races, and completion rate.
gold_query: SELECT d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) as total_races, SUM(CASE WHEN r.position IS NOT NULL AND r.position > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed_races, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.position IS NOT NULL AND r.position > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) as completion_rate FROM ErgastF1.results r JOIN ErgastF1.drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY completion_rate DESC LIMIT 30
submitted_query:
SELECT d.forename AS first_name,
       d.surname AS last_name,
       COUNT(r.raceId) AS total_races,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.position IS NOT NULL AND r.position > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_races,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.position IS NOT NULL AND r.position > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / COUNT(r.raceId) AS completion_rate
FROM ErgastF1.results r
JOIN ErgastF1.drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
HAVING COUNT(r.raceId) >= 50
ORDER BY completion_rate DESC
LIMIT 30;

prompt: Find the top 3 F1 rookie drivers ordered by their start count (highest first) then surname (descending).
gold_query: SELECT d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) as career_starts FROM ErgastF1.results r JOIN ErgastF1.drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) < 20 ORDER BY career_starts DESC, d.surname DESC LIMIT 3
submitted_query:
WITH rookie_counts AS (
 SELECT r.driverId, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS start_count
 FROM ErgastF1.results r
 GROUP BY r.driverId
 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) < 20
)
SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, rc.start_count
FROM rookie_counts rc
JOIN ErgastF1.drivers d ON rc.driverId = d.driverId
ORDER BY rc.start_count DESC, d.surname DESC
LIMIT 3;

prompt: What is the total amount of performing loans by district name?
gold_query: SELECT d.A2 as district_name, SUM(l.amount) as total_loan_amount FROM financial.district d JOIN financial.account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN financial.loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.status = 'A' AND d.district_id != 1 GROUP BY d.A2
submitted_query:
WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT district_id
  FROM financial.account
  GROUP BY district_id
  HAVING COUNT(account_id) >= 50
),
performing_loans AS (
  SELECT l.amount, a.district_id
  FROM financial.loan l
  JOIN financial.account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE l.status = 'A'
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN pl.district_id = 1 THEN d.A2
    WHEN pl.district_id BETWEEN 70 AND 77 THEN 'Eastern Region'
    WHEN pl.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM qualifying) THEN d.A2
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS district_name,
  SUM(pl.amount) AS total_performing_loan_amount
FROM performing_loans pl
LEFT JOIN financial.district d ON pl.district_id = d.district_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY district_name;

prompt: Show carrier performance with counts of on-time, moderately delayed, and severely delayed flights.
gold_query: SELECT UniqueCarrier, SUM(CASE WHEN ArrDelayMinutes <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as on_time, SUM(CASE WHEN ArrDelayMinutes > 15 AND ArrDelayMinutes <= 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as moderate_delays, SUM(CASE WHEN ArrDelayMinutes > 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as severe_delays FROM Airline.On_Time_On_Time_Performance_2016_1 WHERE DepTime IS NOT NULL AND ArrTime IS NOT NULL AND Cancelled = 0 AND (WeatherDelay IS NULL OR WeatherDelay = 0) GROUP BY UniqueCarrier
submitted_query:
SELECT c.Code AS Carrier,
       c.Description AS CarrierName,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.ArrDelayMinutes <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OnTimeCount,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.ArrDelayMinutes > 15 AND f.ArrDelayMinutes <= 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ModerateDelayCount,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.ArrDelayMinutes > 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SevereDelayCount
FROM Airline.On_Time_On_Time_Performance_2016_1 f
JOIN Airline.L_UNIQUE_CARRIERS c ON f.UniqueCarrier = c.Code
WHERE f.DepTime IS NOT NULL AND f.ArrTime IS NOT NULL
  AND (f.WeatherDelay IS NULL OR f.WeatherDelay = 0)
GROUP BY c.Code, c.Description
ORDER BY c.Code

prompt: Calculate win rates for White players (with at least 5 games). Return the 30 players with the highest win rates, ordered by win rate descending.
gold_query: SELECT g.white as player, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.game_result = '1-0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) as win_rate FROM Chess.game g JOIN Chess.opening o ON g.opening_id = o.opening_id WHERE o.name NOT LIKE '%French%' AND o.name NOT LIKE '%Sicilian%' GROUP BY g.white HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY win_rate DESC LIMIT 30
submitted_query:
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT g.white,
           CASE WHEN g.game_result = '1-0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS win
    FROM Chess.game g
    LEFT JOIN Chess.opening o ON g.opening_id = o.opening_id
    WHERE g.whiteElo IS NOT NULL
      AND g.BlackElo IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT (o.name LIKE '%French%' OR g.opening LIKE '%French%')
      AND NOT (o.name LIKE '%Sicilian%' OR g.opening LIKE '%Sicilian%')
)
SELECT white,
       SUM(win)::FLOAT / COUNT(*) AS win_rate,
       COUNT(*) AS total_games
FROM filtered
GROUP BY white
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY win_rate DESC, total_games DESC
LIMIT 30;

prompt: Find salary statistics for departments where salary statistics can be reported. Show me employee count and average salary by department name.
gold_query: SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_no) as employee_count, AVG(s.salary) as avg_salary FROM employee.dept_emp de JOIN employee.departments d ON de.dept_no = d.dept_no JOIN employee.employees e ON de.emp_no = e.emp_no JOIN employee.salaries s ON e.emp_no = s.emp_no WHERE de.to_date = '9999-01-01' AND s.to_date = '9999-01-01' GROUP BY d.dept_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_no) >= 5
submitted_query:
WITH latest_de AS (
  SELECT de.emp_no, de.dept_no,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY de.emp_no ORDER BY de.from_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM employee.dept_emp de
  WHERE de.to_date = '9999-01-01'
),
curr_sal AS (
  SELECT s.emp_no, s.salary
  FROM employee.salaries s
  WHERE s.to_date = '9999-01-01'
)
SELECT d.dept_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ld.emp_no) AS employee_count,
       AVG(cs.salary) AS avg_salary
FROM latest_de ld
JOIN employee.departments d ON ld.dept_no = d.dept_no
JOIN curr_sal cs ON ld.emp_no = cs.emp_no
WHERE ld.rn = 1
  AND ld.emp_no NOT IN (SELECT emp_no FROM employee.dept_manager WHERE to_date = '9999-01-01')
GROUP BY d.dept_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.emp_no) >= 5
ORDER BY d.dept_name;

prompt: For each ECO code, show the game count, white wins, black wins, and draws. Only include ECO codes with at least 5 games.
gold_query: SELECT g.ECO, COUNT(*) as game_count, SUM(CASE WHEN g.game_result = '1-0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as white_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN g.game_result = '0-1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as black_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN g.game_result = '1/2-1/2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as draws FROM Chess.game g JOIN Chess.opening o ON g.opening_id = o.opening_id WHERE o.name NOT LIKE '%French%' AND o.name NOT LIKE '%Sicilian%' AND g.ECO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.ECO HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
submitted_query:
SELECT g.ECO AS eco,
       COUNT(*) AS game_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN g.game_result = '1-0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS white_wins,
       SUM(CASE WHEN g.game_result = '0-1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS black_wins,
       SUM(CASE WHEN g.game_result = '1/2-1/2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draws

prompt: Compare Mercedes teammate performance in the 2015 F1 season, showing race-by-race position comparisons where both drivers finished. Return raceId, year, constructor name, driver1 surname, driver2 surname, driver1_pos, and driver2_pos.
gold_query: SELECT r1.raceId, ra.year, c.name as constructor, d1.surname as driver1, d2.surname as driver2, r1.position as driver1_pos, r2.position as driver2_pos FROM ErgastF1.results r1 JOIN ErgastF1.results r2 ON r1.raceId = r2.raceId AND r1.constructorId = r2.constructorId AND r1.driverId < r2.driverId JOIN ErgastF1.drivers d1 ON r1.driverId = d1.driverId JOIN ErgastF1.drivers d2 ON r2.driverId = d2.driverId JOIN ErgastF1.constructors c ON r1.constructorId = c.constructorId JOIN ErgastF1.races ra ON r1.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE r1.position IS NOT NULL AND r2.position IS NOT NULL AND r1.position > 0 AND r2.position > 0 AND ra.year = 2015 AND c.name = 'Mercedes'
submitted_query:
SELECT r1.raceId,
       ra.year,
       c.constructorRef AS constructor_name,
       d1.driverRef AS driver1_surname,
       d2.driverRef AS driver2_surname,
       r1.position AS driver1_pos,
       r2.position AS driver2_pos
FROM ErgastF1.results r1
JOIN ErgastF1.results r2
  ON r1.raceId = r2.raceId
 AND r1.constructorId = r2.constructorId
JOIN ErgastF1.races ra ON r1.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN ErgastF1.constructors c ON r1.constructorId = c.constructorId
JOIN ErgastF1.drivers d1 ON r1.driverId = d1.driverId
JOIN ErgastF1.drivers d2 ON r2.driverId = d2.driverId
WHERE ra.year = 2015
  AND c.constructorRef = 'mercedes'
  AND r1.position IS NOT NULL AND r1.position > 0
  AND r2.position IS NOT NULL AND r2.position > 0
  AND d1.driverRef IN ('hamilton','rosberg')
  AND d2.driverRef IN ('hamilton','rosberg')

ORDER BY r1.raceId;

  WHERE de.to_date = '9999-01-01'
)

FROM latest_dept ld
JOIN employee.employees e ON ld.emp_no = e.emp_no
JOIN employee.departments d ON ld.dept_no = d.dept_no
